recipe.name: Captcha Solver (container deployment)
test: python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('.').glob('*/*.py')]; print('SYNTAX_OK')"
bash -n entrypoint.sh && bash -n deploy/coolify-provision.sh && bash -n tools/bench_parallel_http.sh && bash -n tools/verify-edge.sh && bash -n tools/verify-edge-login.sh && echo SHELL_SYNTAX_OK

python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; missing=[str(p) for p in ['Dockerfile','entrypoint.sh','compose.coolify.yaml','deploy/cloudflared-captcha.service','deploy/coolify-provision.sh','.dockerignore'] if not pathlib.Path(p).exists()]; sys.exit('missing deployment files: '+', '.join(missing)) if missing else print('DEPLOY_FILES_OK')"

tmp=$(mktemp -d) && printf '# placeholder\n' > "$tmp/env" && CAPTCHA_ENV_FILE="$tmp/env" CAPTCHA_BROWSER_DIR="$tmp/browser" CAPTCHA_FONTS_DIR="$tmp/fonts" CAPTCHA_GEOIP_DIR="$tmp/geoip" CAPTCHA_ARKOSE_MODELS_DIR="$tmp/arkose" CAPTCHA_APIKEY_FILE="$tmp/apikey.txt" docker compose -f compose.coolify.yaml config --quiet && echo COMPOSE_VALID; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

python3 -c "import pathlib,re,sys; t=pathlib.Path('compose.coolify.yaml').read_text(); bad=[m for m in re.findall(r'^\\s*-\\s*(\\S+)', t, re.M) if m.startswith(('./','../'))]; sys.exit('relative bind mount found: '+str(bad)) if bad else print('MOUNTS_ABSOLUTE_OK')"

python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('compose.coolify.yaml').read_text(); ok='127.0.0.1:8877:8877' in t and 'SOLVER_BIND_HOST: 0.0.0.0' in t; sys.exit('publish/bind shape wrong') if not ok else print('BIND_SHAPE_OK')"

python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('.env.production'); t=p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''; d=chr(36); bad=[l.split('=')[0] for l in t.splitlines() if '=' in l and not l.strip().startswith('#') and d in l and d*2 not in l]; sys.exit('unescaped '+d+' in .env.production ('+', '.join(bad)+') — docker compose interpolates env_file values, so a scrypt digest arrives truncated; write '+d*2+' instead') if bad else print('ENV_ESCAPING_OK')"
evidence: tools/check_license_patch.py asserts the pinned browser build carries the license patch on every REQUIRED symbol (Start/End) and reports the optional fingerprint-key-handshake symbol that costs ~25s per launch when unpatched. Proven to fail: run against chrome.orig-backup it exits 1 naming both unpatched symbols.
tools/check_env_example.py (upstream) asserts .env.example covers every variable the code reads and boots a working configuration.
Syntax phase: every *.py under the solver packages must parse; a bad edit in a solver would otherwise only surface when that captcha type is requested.
Shell syntax phase: bash -n on every script the deployment runs.
Deploy-file phase: the container artifacts must exist — a missing Dockerfile/compose/unit is a broken deployment, not a style issue.

Compose phase: `docker compose config --quiet` against throwaway paths, so an interpolation error or a broken YAML structure fails here instead of at deploy time. Self-contained by design: a fresh clone has no production env file, and requiring one would make the recipe unrunnable outside the deployed host.

Mount phase: bind mounts must be absolute or variable-driven. A relative mount resolves against Coolify's own application directory, so the app boots against an empty database — the failure a health check cannot see.

Bind shape phase: the app binds the container interface while the publish stays on host loopback. Both halves are required — binding 127.0.0.1 inside the container makes the publish unreachable, and publishing on 0.0.0.0 exposes the service directly.

Env-escaping phase: docker compose interpolates $VAR inside env_file values, so an unescaped scrypt digest arrives truncated at the first $ and the console rejects every password. Runs only when .env.production exists (it is gitignored), so a fresh clone reports OK.

No live /solve call and no container start: solving needs network plus a real captcha target, and the container is already running under Coolify with its own tunnel. Live checks live in tools/verify-edge.sh, tools/verify-edge-login.sh and tools/bench_parallel_http.sh, run manually.
